title: Day 16 — Photosensors and the Solar Tracker

slides.title: Where we are
items: Your servo is wired on the regulator board's 5 V and follows the potentiometer on A0, with your completed Day15_servo_template.c on the Nucleo.

The reading introduced the photocell, a resistor whose resistance falls as more light falls on it, the voltage divider that turns that resistance into a voltage for the ADC, and the photocell's datasheet.
Today: the photocell in the divider, Part 1 of Lab 8, the photocells on the tracker arm, and the feedback loop that points the arm at the light.
